title: HTTP Gateway 502 and Unhealthy Upstream
problem_summary: A reverse proxy or API gateway returns 502 when it cannot connect to a healthy configured upstream.
preconditions: A gateway or reverse proxy forwards requests to an upstream service

steps.instruction: Inspect gateway health and upstream selection logs.
steps.expected_result: The gateway identifies at least one healthy upstream.
steps.failure_action: Check the configured upstream targets and health-check results.

steps.instruction: Check reachability from the gateway to each configured upstream.
steps.expected_result: The gateway can reach a healthy backend on its configured port.
steps.failure_action: Correct only a confirmed target, port, or network policy issue.

verification_checks.description: Repeat the request through the gateway.
verification_checks.success_condition: The gateway returns the backend response rather than a 502.

gateway_no_healthy_upstream.meaning: Gateway reports that no configured upstream is healthy

gateway_failure_uncertain.meaning: The 502 symptom alone does not identify the failing layer

inspect_upstream_health.meaning: Inspect gateway health-check results for configured upstreams

verify_gateway_target.meaning: Check the configured upstream host and port

inspect_gateway_error_logs.meaning: Collect the relevant gateway error details
